name: RVRC Holding AB (publ)
summary: RVRC Holding AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, engages in the e-commerce of active outdoor clothing and equipment in Germany, Sweden, and internationally. The company offers pants, alpine products for demanding conditions, cross-country skiing, cycling, outwear for cold climates, softshell and hybrid products, fleece and mid-layers, base layers, and accessories, such as hats, caps, gloves, and socks. It sells its products under the RevolutionRace brand name. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Borås, Sweden.
